mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement ( id, title, settled_on, status, admin_token_hash, bank, account_number, account_holder, pay_link, shared_at, account_purge_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{title}, #{settledOn}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'SHARED'), #{adminTokenHash}, #{bank}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountHolder}, #{payLink}, #{sharedAt}, #{accountPurgeAt}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, settled_on, status, admin_token_hash, bank, account_number, account_holder, pay_link, created_at, shared_at, account_purge_at, expires_at FROM settlement WHERE id = #{id}
